description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - The names Persons or Categories of Persons to whom a Certificate of Exemptions were issued
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). It concerns the issuance of certificates of exemption from licensing requirements for electricity generation, which constitutes a regulatory matter. The content involves the exercise of statutory powers to create exemptions from regulatory compliance, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure or other specialized categories.
